title: Banda El Recodo Banks Its 20th No. 1 on Regional Mexican Airplay Chart With ‘Solo Tú’
summary: The banda version is a remake of Camilo Sesto’s song from his 1976 album, Memorias.
contentText:
Banda El Recodo de Cruz Lizárraga celebrates its first No. 1 of 2026 as “Solo Tú” advances from No. 4 to lead Billboard ’s Regional Mexican Airplay chart (dated Jan. 24). A cover of Camilo Sesto’s song — which first appeared on the Spaniard’s 1976 album, Memorias — the new banda version earns El Recodo its 20th champ on the chart.

“Solo Tú,” released Oct. 31 on El Recodo/FONO/UMLE, marks FONO’s second champ of 2026 . The regional Mexican label replaces itself at No. 1, as another reimagined track, “Una Noche Contigo” by La Arrolladora Banda El Limón and Juanes, slips 1-3 following a 12% decline in impressions.

Achieving the title of Greatest Gainer for the week, “Solo Tú” ascends to No. 1 with a 39% surge in audience impressions, to 7.2 million, during the tracking week ending Jan. 15, according to Luminate. This milestone earns El Recodo its 20th No. 1 on the Regional Mexican Airplay chart. Here is a summary of the acts with the most No. 1 since the chart’s inception in 1994:

Artist, No. 1s

- Calibre 50, 27

- Banda MS de Sergio Lizárraga, 22

- Intocable, 21

- La Arrolladora Banda el Limón de René Camacho, 21

- Banda El Recodo de Cruz Lizárraga, 20

- Los Tigres del Norte, 18

- Christian Nodal, 17

“Solo Tú” becomes the second song with the same title to reach the top of the chart, after Calibre 50’s five-week chart-topper in 2020 (not a Sesto cover).

“Solo Tú” is part of El Recodo’s forthcoming set, Madre de Todas Las Bandas , which does not yet have a release date.
